name: dev.ocean/chrome-devtools
description: Control the owner's real, signed-in Chromium browser (Chrome by default; Brave, Edge, Arc, Vivaldi, Opera or Chromium through `ocean browser use`) through the ocean-browser-mcp package (pinned Chrome DevTools MCP): tabs, navigation, clicks, forms, uploads, screenshots, console and network errors. Reads every open tab and acts inside any signed-in session of the attached browser, for every client wired to it. The browser asks to allow the connection once: one background connection (disconnected after 8 idle hours) serves every session; a pointer and a blue frame show which tab the agent is using. Cookies and auth headers are redacted, file:// pages are refused, and URL patterns can be blocked. Writes a usage log (tool names and sizes, no URLs), screenshot previews and oversized page snapshots under ~/.local/state/ocean-browser-mcp (kept 7 days). The filesystem permission is declared for consent but not enforced at runtime, and the npm package is pinned by version, not by digest.

server.name: dev.ocean/chrome-devtools
server.description: ocean-browser-mcp runs Chrome DevTools MCP 1.13.0 attached to the owner's running Chromium browser, with usage statistics and CrUX lookups off, so page URLs stay on this machine.

packageArguments.name: --userDataDir
packageArguments.description: Profile root of the Chromium browser to attach to; unset attaches to Chrome. Set with `ocean browser use <name|path>`.

environmentVariables.name: CHROME_DEVTOOLS_MCP_NO_UPDATE_CHECKS
environmentVariables.description: Skips upstream's update check (an npm child process and a registry fetch) on every start; the version is pinned.

environmentVariables.name: OCEAN_BROWSER_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Tool profile: standard (default), full, lean or slim. Set with `ocean browser profile <name>`.

environmentVariables.name: OCEAN_BROWSER_BLOCKED
environmentVariables.description: URL patterns the browser refuses while attached, comma- or newline-separated. Set with `ocean browser block`.

environmentVariables.name: OCEAN_BROWSER_CURSOR
environmentVariables.description: 0 hides the agent pointer and frame.

environmentVariables.name: OCEAN_BROWSER_SHARED
environmentVariables.description: 0 gives each session its own connection (and its own allow prompt).

environmentVariables.name: OCEAN_BROWSER_IDLE_MIN
environmentVariables.description: Minutes without a call before the shared connection disconnects (default 480; 0 or never keeps it).

environmentVariables.name: OCEAN_BROWSER_SNAPSHOT_MAX_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Largest page snapshot sent whole, in characters (default 40000; 0 = no cap). Larger ones keep interactive elements and headings; the whole tree is saved to a file.
